body:
B0-C EXPECTED-DATA ORACLE V2 — FINITE AMENDED SYNTHESIS. Documentation/data specification only; no code, source read, media, dependency, runtime, provider, generator, or implementation authority.

V1 is not accepted. This V2 adopts the blocker-class findings in post-01M19QETDMKVJTFNSHV6ZWTE9K, post-01M19QG3R6VZN03MZQQWG08VYA, post-01M19QGFX2Z19F3V7E4MKQ08WN, and the independent video-admission review. It restores the full accepted B0-C scope from decision post-01M19ERGZJXV8XSS6HR1FTDZQK while retaining the F0 V3 authority ceiling.

## 1. One complete semantic artifact and one stable scientific identity

The future canonical artifact is `B0CExpectedDataV2`:

- a semantic header;
- the complete ordered local fixture table;
- the complete ordered case table;
- exact typed expected outcomes;
- exact identity preimages, expected identity values, and explanatory Same/Different/Refuse assertions.

The semantic header binds namespace, schema version, canonical-encoding version, canonical-schema byte digest, digest primitive/version and domain separator, normalized rational/arithmetic bounds, signed rounding and interval-enclosure policies, endpoint semantics, tolerance semantics, and ordering/normalization rules for every nested collection.

Every complete case record is encoded atomically and binds:

- caseId and owner `C1B | C1C | C1D | C1F`;
- class `Control | FixtureMutation | AdapterMutation`;
- controlCaseId when applicable;
- exact tagged input family and complete input payload;
- exact tagged expected outcome and complete payload;
- identity expectations;
- mutation operator, base/control digest, derived-input or operator digest, and detecting court.

There are no parallel, independently ordered projections of “inputs,” “outputs,” and “assertions.” Canonical nested ordering is explicit and never depends on map iteration.

The stable scientific coordinate is:

`ExpectedDataId = H(domainSeparator, schemaBytesDigest, canonicalBytes(entire semantic payload))`.

The payload excludes only its own `ExpectedDataId` field and nonsemantic derivation, review, execution-attempt, and realization receipts. Changing a fixture, case identity, owner, control pairing, input, outcome, mutation operator, detecting court, arithmetic policy, canonicalization rule, or expected identity changes `ExpectedDataId`.

For every successful identity-bearing expected result, the artifact freezes an `ExpectedIdentity` containing:

- the identity kind;
- the complete normalized semantic preimage in declared field order;
- its domain separator and digest version;
- the exact independently computed digest/public value.

This applies to mapping-relation identity, mapping-derivation identity, support identity where asserted, and finalized bundle/edition identity. Same/Different remains the mutation explanation, but JVM, JS, and Native must each equal the same frozen expected constant. A lawful identity-changing mutation has its own frozen preimage/value. Refusal and unestablished outcomes mint no invented ID.

The documentation receipts remain non-inheriting:

`DerivationReceiptId = H(ExpectedDataId, normative equations and hand method, worksheet/transcript digest)`

`ReviewReceiptId = H(ExpectedDataId, DerivationReceiptId, independent reviewer, independently recomputed numeric and identity fields, disposition)`

The independent reviewer recomputes every numeric field, canonical preimage, expected digest, and Same/Different/Refuse assertion without using future C1 rational, timestamp, mapping, canonicalization, fingerprint, or finalization code.

`OracleRealizationId` is deliberately undefined in B0-C. A later separately authorized F0 realization must bind `ExpectedDataId`, exact realized case-set and coverage, the F0 Intent/request identity, independent implementation/runtime/dependency identity, realized outputs, and cache identity. A partial realization cannot claim realization of the full expected-data artifact. C1 is the system under test and may emit only conformance evidence against `ExpectedDataId`.

## 2. Typed outcome families, not alternatives or strings

Each tagged input family has one closed expected-outcome family. The canonical schema distinguishes at least:

- timestamp-envelope normalization, including independently present/missing PTS and DTS, unknown duration, and typed source-contract/arithmetic refusals;
- presentation-evidence availability, so a DTS-only envelope may retain decode provenance without constructing presentation evidence;
- relation construction: `Established`, `Unestablished(MissingAnchorEvidence)`, or `Refused(RelationViolation)`;
- projection: exactly `Exact | Quantized | Enclosing | Gap | OutsideDomain | NoCorrespondence | Ambiguous | Refused`;
- reverse query: exact singleton, complete canonical occurrence-scoped set, hold/preimage witness, no correspondence, outside domain, ambiguity under a require-unique query, or refusal;
- unresolved-manifest finalization: finalized or an exact typed refusal such as unresolved mapping reference;
- legacy/timed-transcript conformance and closed synthetic-record dispositions.

Missingness, `Option`, generic error strings, and phrases such as “unestablished/refused” or “set or Ambiguous” cannot stand in for these tagged results.

## 3. Mutation algebra

Every mutation leaf has its own caseId and same-mechanism controlCaseId.

`FixtureMutation` applies one canonical typed operator to the referenced control. A single operator may be structurally multi-field, for example `Swap(PTS,DTS)`; the one-change law is one declared operator, not one scalar slot. It binds the control's canonical digest, operator and parameters, and the exact derived-input digest.

`AdapterMutation` describes one forbidden repair or guard rewrite whose defect is behavioral rather than a changed input record, for example `ClampPtsToDts`, `RelabelPtsAsDts`, `DiscardTimestampField`, `TreatSentinelAsPresent`, `MapOverflowToMissing`, `BridgeGap`, or `SelectFirstPreimage`. It binds the control, exact operator-specification digest, witness input/outcome, and detecting court; it does not invent a mutated-input digest when no data mutation exists.

Every listed swap, relabel, reorder, discard, guard removal, gap bridge, first-match selection, or identity-field omission is therefore mechanically representable and independently killable.

## 4. Normative two-acquisition-run ClockRepair fixture

The repaired target is a dedicated synthetic diagnostic axis, never film edition playback:

- run A local `[0,5)` in epoch/occurrence A maps exactly to diagnostic `[0,5)`;
- run B resets to local `[0,5)` in distinct epoch/occurrence B and maps exactly to diagnostic `[7,12)`;
- diagnostic `[5,7)` is an explicit no-sample gap with a declared seam;
- equal local tick 1 in A and B denotes distinct coordinates and maps to diagnostic 1 and 8;
- reverse returns the correct run-scoped preimage(s);
- composition cannot bridge `[5,7)`;
- changing run order, run identity, gap, anchor, epoch, occurrence, or seam changes relation/support identity or refuses;
- absent required anchor evidence is exactly `RelationConstructionOutcome.Unestablished(MissingAnchorEvidence)`, never guessed continuity and never an operational projection refusal.

This is a mathematical two-acquisition-run ClockRepair fixture. It is not F0's two-clean-build determinism court and it is not an edition mapping. Synthetic edition/track composition cases remain separately owned by C1-D; D0 later supplies the first source-specific mapping and realized repair receipt.

## 5. Exact finite case roster

### C1-B — timestamp envelopes and refusals

- B01: all four PTS/DTS presence combinations remain independent; packet sentinel provenance becomes field missingness and cannot construct a coordinate.
- B02: packet-field INT64_MIN is missing, while rescale overflow producing the same raw value is `Refused(Arithmetic)`. Control `4611686018427387903 * 2` is representable; `4611686018427387904 * 2` refuses.
- B03: PASS_MINMAX preserves a packet sentinel's missingness provenance; `-1` is a lawful present signed tick. Erasing provenance or constructing Present(INT64_MIN) fails.
- B04: PTS=5,DTS=5 accepts; PTS=4,DTS=5 is `Refused(PacketOrderViolation)` with originals and provenance retained. Swap, clamp, relabel, reorder, and discard are distinct adapter-mutation leaves and fail.
- B05: duration +1 is known positive; 0 is `UnknownDuration`; -1 is a typed refusal. Unknown zero cannot become a legacy empty interval, instant, or measured zero.
- B06: negative PTS/DTS with a nonzero negative origin remain lawful and exact. DTS-only retains decode provenance but presentation evidence is exactly unavailable due to missing PTS.

### C1-C — projection, shared mapping laws, and ClockRepair

- C01: 1/4 second to milliseconds is `Exact(250)`; 2/8 normalizes to the same exact identity.
- C02: 1/3 second under declared floor is `Quantized(333,residual=1/3)`, never Exact(333); distinct rationals rounding to 333 retain distinct residuals.
- C03: -1/3 second under floor is `Quantized(-334,residual=2/3)`; outward enclosure of `[1/3,2/3)` seconds is tagged `[333,667)` milliseconds, never exact coverage.
- C04: an arbitrary-precision result outside requested signed bounds is `Refused(Arithmetic)` and cannot be relabelled Missing, Gap, OutsideDomain, NoCorrespondence, or Ambiguous.
- C05: one relation `[0,10) -> [100,120)` and a collinear split at 4 without a seam have the same frozen relation identity and distinct frozen mapping-derivation identities.
- C06: independently changing family, direction, intercept, endpoint, occurrence, or explicit seam changes exact identity or refuses; every leaf has a positive control and expected identity constant.
- C07: equal raw tick 7 in different epochs/occurrences remains distinct. Equal-coefficient segments separated by an epoch/discontinuity seam cannot coalesce.
- C08: exact bijective round-trip succeeds; composition preserves an explicit intermediate gap; endpoint-only bridging fails; values merely within fitted tolerance remain unequal.
- C09: the run-A/run-B diagnostic fixture preserves reset, run identity, seam, diagnostic gap, exact occurrence-scoped reverse, and non-bridging composition. Guessed concatenation or deletion of the diagnostic seam fails.

### C1-D — TrackComposition, correspondence, and finalization

- D01: mapped sections around target `[4,6)` yield exact `Gap` inside; endpoint bridging fails.
- D02: a source instant held over target `[5,8)` reverses to an exact tagged hold/preimage witness carrying source instant and target extent; it never selects an arbitrary first point.
- D03: repeated or reordered source material has distinct occurrence IDs; an all-preimages query returns the complete canonical occurrence-scoped set. Dropping occurrence or selecting first fails.
- D04a: an in-domain all-preimages correspondence query returns its complete frozen canonical set.
- D04b: the same multi-preimage relation under a require-unique query returns exactly `Ambiguous`.
- D04c: an in-domain absent correspondence returns exactly `NoCorrespondence`.
- D04d: a query outside the relation domain returns exactly `OutsideDomain`.
- D05: an unresolved local mapping reference yields an exact finalization refusal. Once every canonical relation validates, finalization succeeds with frozen expected bundle/edition identity. Changing relation, direction, family, gap, hold, occurrence, epoch, seam, endpoint, rendition, or checksum changes exact identity or refuses.

### C1-F — legacy conformance and synthetic record accounting

- F01: `TranscriptTurn.audio = None` is absent legacy timing.
- F02: `Some(AudioSpan([1000,1500)))` is a nonempty overlay; lookup at 1000 succeeds and 1500 does not.
- F03: `Some(AudioSpan([2000,2000)))` is an explicit legacy-empty overlay containing no instant; lookup at 2000 does not succeed.
- F04: native packet duration 0 is `UnknownDuration` and is unequal to F01, F03, mapping gap, and conversion refusal.
- F05: an ordinary synthetic record receives exactly `Retained`.
- F06: an explicit break-marker record receives exactly `Dropped(BreakMarker)`.
- F07: optional TR present and missing remain distinct tagged record states.
- F08: a record without a required run coordinate receives exactly `MissingCoordinate`; it is not silently absent.
- F09: an overlapping-record all-preimages query returns every lawful occurrence-scoped preimage in canonical order.
- F10a: a within-run mapping control is exact.
- F10b: under an explicit RejectCrossBreak policy, a record crossing a declared break yields exactly `Refused(CrossesDeclaredBreak)`.
- F10c: under an explicit SplitAtBreak policy, the same geometry yields the exact ordered nonempty split support and never a hull bridging the gap.
- F11: over the declared synthetic record universe, every input record has exactly one closed disposition. Missing or duplicate membership yields an exact failed/incomplete accounting outcome. This does not authorize source rates; B0-D still owns Established/Unestablished disclosure and rate policy.

The oracle uses deliberately non-Sherlock axes, coordinates, cardinalities, and row keys. It contains no copied descriptions, speakers, words, frames, participant recall, or reconstructable episode fingerprint.

## 6. Claim ceiling and dependency

B0-C V2 may establish only a versioned normative repair specification, exact independently reviewed mathematical and record expectations, complete semantic expected-data identity, and documentation receipts. It does not establish executable replay, runtime independence, toolchain reproducibility, source-specific repair, media validity, reader/provider behavior, coverage rates, boundaries, narrative quality, or legal permission.

C1-T later binds every case, construction door, refusal, exact identity constant, mutation, and JVM/JS/Native court into the public type matrix. C1-B/C/D/F execute only their owned rows. Aggregate C1 cannot close until every row passes against the same `ExpectedDataId`. F0 may later realize exact declared coverage without rewriting expected data. D0 remains the first source-specific reader.

If this exact V2 receives independent acceptance, mark it actionable for a bounded B0-C documentation/data bead producing the canonical expected-data file, derivation worksheet, and independent review receipt. Board acceptance alone does not close B0-C and grants no source, code, runtime, dependency, provider, public-name, API, or implementation authority.

Reviewers: ACCEPT / ACCEPT-AS-AMENDED / OBJECT under the four blocker classes only.
